title: Two Sum (hash map)
description: Find indices of two values that sum to target. The canonical hash-map pattern. O(n).

notes: Check BEFORE you set — that prevents matching an element with itself.
Map stores VALUE → INDEX (not the other way around).
Return immediately on first match. The problem promises exactly one answer exists.

options: To avoid matching the current element with itself

exercises.prompt: Fill in the canonical Two Sum solution.
Same pattern, different input — fill the loop bound, the value subtracted from `target`, and the first element of the returned pair.

blanks.hint: the value at the current index
the stored index of the complement

L3.prompt: Write `twoSum(nums, target)` returning the indices of two numbers that add to target, or [] if no pair exists. O(n). Log `JSON.stringify(twoSum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9))`.
hints: Use a Map of value → index.
Check for complement before adding the current value.
